title: Adsorptive fractionation of extracellular polymeric substances on iron oxyhydroxides: impact on copper binding
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00601E, Paper
Dan Luo, Sipei Yang, Haoyang Wang, Zhibin Wu, Xiaomin Gong, Yuan Yang, Yunshan Liang, Yaoyu Zhou
Iron oxyhydroxides preferentially adsorb proteins/aromatic compounds during EPS fractionation, altering Cu binding affinity to residual organics and the sequence between carboxyls and polysaccharides.
